compute_calibration_label_predictions: compute calibration metrics from a list of LabelPrediction objects to get expected, max, and total error
get_bucket_scores_probabilities: organize posterior probabilities into configurable buckets and return bucket values with their indices
get_bucket_confidence_averages: compute the average confidence score for each probability bucket from bucketed values
calculate_error_metrics: calculate expected calibration error, maximum calibration error, and total calibration error from bucketed predictions
print_calibration_metrics: print the expected error, max error, and total error calibration metrics to the console
